question.text: The Competition Act 2002 is administered by:

explanation.text: The Logic: The NISM Series-XV workbook states that the Competition Act, 2002 — which replaced the MRTP Act, 1969 — is administered by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. The Trap: Competition regulation is an MCA mandate; SEBI handles securities-market matters, RBI handles banking and monetary policy, and the Ministry of Defence has no role here. Note: Detailed CCI thresholds for M&A review and any SEBI-specific carve-outs are not stated on the checked workbook page and would require a current CCI/SEBI source; the source-backed point is MCA's administration of the Competition Act.
